correctness.rationale: The reduced Swiatkowski weight-three complex has verified integer chain dimensions (680,2400,2700,960) and square-zero differentials. Mod-3 ranks (679,1715,960) are rational lower bounds; H0 dimension and injectivity of d3 give matching upper bounds for d1,d3, and the explicit surjection H1(B3(P)) onto the rank-six graph cycle space forces rank(d2)<=1715. Hence rational Betti (1,6,25,0). The oriented edge sign is retained in H1 character (6,0,-2,0,0,0,1). The signed fixed-basis and orbit-generating Lefschetz calculations independently give (20,-2,4,-1,1,2,0), yielding H2 character (25,-3,1,-2,0,1,0). Exact S5 inner products recover the stated irreducibles. A standalone executable and exact recorded output verify all finite computations. Integral torsion and independence are not claimed.

value.rationale: Complete symmetry action on a natural 25-dimensional H2 of the canonical highly symmetric nonplanar Petersen graph with three indistinguishable particles, including different irreducible multiplicities not recoverable from homology ranks. The calculation proves the full symmetry quotient is rationally acyclic; its H2 representation differs qualitatively from the 2-point case and is a useful structural benchmark for graph braid equivariance.
